abilities.name: Blinding Light
abilities.effect: This **^^Manifestation^^** cannot be targeted by shooting attacks. In addition, a unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks if it is impossible to draw a straight line from a model in the attacking unit to a model in the target unit without that line passing across this **^^Manifestation^^**.
abilities.effectPlain: This Manifestation cannot be targeted by shooting attacks. In addition, a unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks if it is impossible to draw a straight line from a model in the attacking unit to a model in the target unit without that line passing across this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Battle Fury
abilities.effect: This unit can use 2 **^^Fight^^** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **^^Strike‑last^^** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.effectPlain: This unit can use 2 Fight abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has Strike‑last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: 'I'll Get There Myself!'
abilities.effect: This unit cannot be set up in reserve and cannot be targeted by abilities that would remove it from the battlefield.
abilities.effectPlain: This unit cannot be set up in reserve and cannot be targeted by abilities that would remove it from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **^^Manifestation^^**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.
abilities.effectPlain: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Arcane Passage
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect: The next time the target uses a non-**^^Summon Spell^^** ability this phase, add 1 to the casting value of that spell. When picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from either part of this **^^Manifestation^^** instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to either part of this **^^Manifestation^^** instead of to the caster for the purposes of the 'Unbind' ability.
abilities.effectPlain: The next time the target uses a non-Summon Spell ability this phase, add 1 to the casting value of that spell. When picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from either part of this Manifestation instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to either part of this Manifestation instead of to the caster for the purposes of the 'Unbind' ability.

abilities.name: Pulled to the Grave
abilities.effect: This **^^Manifestation^^** can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, you can pick an enemy unit that this **^^Manifestation^^** passed across during that move to be the target. Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.effectPlain: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, you can pick an enemy unit that this Manifestation passed across during that move to be the target. Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Mechanisms of Time
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
If there are any friendly **^^Wizards^^** within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^**, pick 1 of the following effects:
***Increase Time Flow***: Until the start of your next turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this **^^Manifestation^^**.
***Decrease Time Flow***: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **^^Wizards^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this **^^Manifestation^^**.
abilities.effectPlain:
If there are any friendly Wizards within 3" of this Manifestation, pick 1 of the following effects:
Increase Time Flow: Until the start of your next turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation.
Decrease Time Flow: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly Wizards while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Restored Vigour
abilities.effect: **Heal (3)** this **^^Manifestation^^**.
abilities.effectPlain: Heal (3) this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Bounteous Healing
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect: **Heal (3)** the target.
abilities.effectPlain: Heal (3) the target.

abilities.name: Ravening Hunger
abilities.declare: If this **^^Manifestation^^** charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.effectPlain: Roll 10 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Devourer of Magics
abilities.effect: If this **^^Manifestation^^** destroyed any enemy **^^Manifestations^^** this turn, Heal (6) this **^^Manifestation^^**.
abilities.effectPlain: If this Manifestation destroyed any enemy Manifestations this turn, Heal (6) this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Arcane Predator
abilities.effect: You can add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this **^^Manifestation^^**, to a maximum of 3, while it is within 18" of any enemy **^^Manifestations^^**, but if you do so, it must end the charge move within 1/2" of an enemy **^^Manifestation^^**.
abilities.effectPlain: You can add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this Manifestation, to a maximum of 3, while it is within 18" of any enemy Manifestations, but if you do so, it must end the charge move within 1/2" of an enemy Manifestation.

abilities.name: Wild Form
abilities.effect: Each time this **^^Manifestation^^** is targeted by the 'Banish Manifestation' ability, if it would be banished, it is not banished. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
abilities.effectPlain: Each time this Manifestation is targeted by the 'Banish Manifestation' ability, if it would be banished, it is not banished. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: Deathly Passage
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of one part of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the other part of this **^^Manifestation^^** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.effectPlain: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the other part of this Manifestation and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **^^Manifestation^^**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.
abilities.effectPlain: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect:
While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Iron Feet** is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.
abilities.effectPlain:
While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its Crushing Iron Feet is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: Mercenary Attitudes
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly non-**^^Unique^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn and while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit:
• You can re-roll run rolls for the target.
• Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• The target cannot be targeted by shooting attacks.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks.
• Add 10 to the target's control score.
abilities.effectPlain:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn and while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit:
• You can re-roll run rolls for the target.
• Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• The target cannot be targeted by shooting attacks.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks.
• Add 10 to the target's control score.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Battle Fury
abilities.declare:
Pick a visible friendly
unit wholly within 12" of this
unit to be the target, then make
a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• The target cannot use **^^Move^^** abilities.
• The target's melee weapons have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)**.
abilities.effectPlain:
Until the start of your next turn:
• The target cannot use Move abilities.
• The target's melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend).

abilities.name: Masked in Plain Sight
abilities.declare: This unit must be deployed using this ability.
abilities.effect:
Set up this unit in reserve **incognito**. It has now been deployed.
Friendly **incognito** units are destroyed at the end of the fifth battle round and not at the start of the fourth battle round.
abilities.effectPlain:
Set up this unit in reserve incognito. It has now been deployed.
Friendly incognito units are destroyed at the end of the fifth battle round and not at the start of the fourth battle round.

abilities.name: Bait and Switch
abilities.declare: This unit can use this ability if it is **incognito**. Pick this unit and a friendly **^^Infantry Hero^^** to be the targets. One target must be **incognito** and the other must be on the battlefield.
abilities.effect:
Set up the incognito target wholly within 6" of the other target and not in combat. Then, remove the other target
from the battlefield and set it up in reserve **incognito**.
If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, set up the friendly **incognito** unit wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and not in combat.
abilities.effectPlain:
Set up the incognito target wholly within 6" of the other target and not in combat. Then, remove the other target
from the battlefield and set it up in reserve incognito.
If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, set up the friendly incognito unit wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and not in combat.

abilities.name: Dancing Blades
abilities.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted by this **^^Manifestation^^**'s attacks.
abilities.effectPlain: Ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted by this Manifestation's attacks.

abilities.name: Phantasmal Translocation
abilities.effect: Pick a part of this **^^Manifestation^^**, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 9" of the other part and more than 3" from all enemy units.
abilities.effectPlain: Pick a part of this Manifestation, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 9" of the other part and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **^^Manifestation^^**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.
abilities.effectPlain: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Ensnaring Soul-drain
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy unit uses a **^^Move^^** ability while it is within 9" of any parts of this Manifestation, the effects of the 'Fly' ability do not apply to that unit. Enemy units cannot be set up within 9" of either part of this **^^Manifestation^^**.
abilities.effectPlain: Each time an enemy unit uses a Move ability while it is within 9" of any parts of this Manifestation, the effects of the 'Fly' ability do not apply to that unit. Enemy units cannot be set up within 9" of either part of this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Traverse the Tides of Death
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Infantry Wizard Hero^^** within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target
abilities.effect: This **^^Manifestation^^** can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^** and not in combat. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.effectPlain: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield within 3" of this Manifestation and not in combat. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect:
While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Iron Feet** is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.
abilities.effectPlain:
While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its Crushing Iron Feet is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: Everyone Aboard!
abilities.declare: Pick up to 1 friendly **^^Infantry Hero^^** and up to 1 friendly non-reinforced, non-**^^Hero Infantry^^** unit that have not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve as this unit's **passengers**. They have now been deployed.
abilities.effectPlain: Set up those units in reserve as this unit's passengers. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: This is Your Stop, Maggots!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit's **passengers** to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up each target wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units. In addition, the targets' melee weapons have **Charge (+1 Damage)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.effectPlain: Set up each target wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units. In addition, the targets' melee weapons have Charge (+1 Damage) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Tendrils of Light and Shadow
abilities.effect: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are within 3" of either part of this **^^Manifestation^^**.
abilities.effectPlain: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are within 3" of either part of this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect:
When a number of damage points equal to this **^^Manifestation^^**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.
Each time this **^^Manifestation^^** moves, both its parts must end within 9" of each other.
Each part of this **^^Manifestation^^** is armed with **Tendrils of Light and Shadow**.
abilities.effectPlain:
When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.
Each time this Manifestation moves, both its parts must end within 9" of each other.
Each part of this Manifestation is armed with Tendrils of Light and Shadow.

abilities.name: Bound for the Great Oubliette
abilities.declare: For each part of this **^^Manifestation^^**, you can pick an enemy unit within 3" of that part to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Subtract a number of inches equal to the roll from the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.
abilities.effectPlain:
Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Subtract a number of inches equal to the roll from the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **^^Manifestation^^**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.
abilities.effectPlain: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Burning Up
abilities.effect: Each time this **^^Manifestation^^** uses a **^^Shoot^^** ability, after that ability has been resolved, allocate 1 damage point to this **^^Manifestation^^** (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point).
abilities.effectPlain: Each time this Manifestation uses a Shoot ability, after that ability has been resolved, allocate 1 damage point to this Manifestation (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point).

abilities.name: Morbid Detonation
abilities.declare: You must, and can only, use this ability if this unit has 6 **maelstrom points**. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed.
abilities.effectPlain: Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this Manifestation is destroyed.

abilities.name: Necrotic Vortex
abilities.effect:
Give this **^^Manifestation^^** 1 **maelstrom point** each time:
• This **^^Manifestation^^** is set up.
• A unit successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this **^^Manifestation^^**.
• A model is slain within 12" of this **^^Manifestation^^**.
This **^^Manifestation^^** can have a maximum of 6 **maelstrom points** at once.
abilities.effectPlain:
Give this Manifestation 1 maelstrom point each time:
• This Manifestation is set up.
• A unit successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this Manifestation.
• A model is slain within 12" of this Manifestation.
This Manifestation can have a maximum of 6 maelstrom points at once.

abilities.name: End Given Form
abilities.effect: This **^^Manifestation^^** can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this **^^Manifestation^^** passed across during that move to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.effectPlain: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Pull of the Nadir
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for friendly and enemy units while they are within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^**.
abilities.effectPlain: Subtract 1 from save rolls for friendly and enemy units while they are within 3" of this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Harbinger of Horror
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this **^^Manifestation^^**'s shooting attacks this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of models in the target unit that were slain this phase, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
abilities.effectPlain: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of models in the target unit that were slain this phase, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Scything Blade
abilities.effect: This **^^Manifestation^^** can move a distance up to its Move characteristic in one direction (see 'The Pendulum Swings'). It can pass through models during that move and can end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this **^^Manifestation^^** passed across during that move or that are within 1/2" of it to be the targets. Roll a D6 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.effectPlain: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic in one direction (see 'The Pendulum Swings'). It can pass through models during that move and can end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move or that are within 1/2" of it to be the targets. Roll a D6 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Pendulum Swings
abilities.effect: This **^^Manifestation^^** cannot use **^^Charge^^** or **^^Fight^^** abilities. In addition, when this **^^Manifestation^^** moves, it must move in a straight line either in the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing or in the opposite direction to the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing
abilities.effectPlain: This Manifestation cannot use Charge or Fight abilities. In addition, when this Manifestation moves, it must move in a straight line either in the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing or in the opposite direction to the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing
